title: toeplitz
summary: Construct a Toeplitz matrix from first-column and first-row vectors.

gpu_support.notes: gpuArray inputs are gathered to the host construction path.

description: `toeplitz(r)` constructs a square Toeplitz matrix from first row `r`. `toeplitz(c,r)` uses `c` as the first column and `r` as the first row.
behaviors: Accepts real or complex scalar and vector inputs.
One-input real calls produce a symmetric Toeplitz matrix from the supplied first row.
One-input complex calls use the supplied vector as the first row, conjugate the off-diagonal first column, and keep the main diagonal at `r(1)`.
Two-input calls use the first column value for the main diagonal when `c(1)` and `r(1)` differ.

Matching `single`, `double`, and all eight native integer classes are preserved exactly. Two integer inputs must use the same class; mixed integer classes and integer/floating mixtures are rejected instead of being silently converted.

Complex single and complex double inputs preserve their floating precision. With RunMat extensions enabled, native complex-integer storage is copied exactly when both components use one integer class.
Resident inputs gather only when the provider lacks a direct construction path, and the result is restored through the provider that owns the input.
Matrix and nonnumeric inputs raise errors.

examples.description: Separate first column and first row
